notice: These are user-supplied general reflections associated with Instagram links. They are not Qur'an quotations, Hadith, tafsir, or religious rulings.

reflections.title: You are not forgotten
reflections.text: A reminder that Allah has not left or forgotten you. Difficult seasons pass; hold on to hope, patience and trust in what lies ahead.

reflections.title: Turn to Allah when words hurt
reflections.text: When words hurt, turn to Allah through praise, remembrance and prayer. Give yourself a moment before responding to pain.

reflections.title: Hope in what is to come
reflections.text: A reflection on hope, relief and the promise of blessings and contentment. Let it encourage patience without treating hardship as a personal failure.

reflections.title: Allah hears your dua
reflections.text: A reflection on Allah's nearness and hearing of prayers. Spiritual comfort can accompany practical steps and reaching out for support.

reflections.title: Make space for remembrance
reflections.related: General reflection · no verse quotation supplied
reflections.text: Prioritise connection with Allah in everyday life. This reflection describes sukoon through dhikr and reliance rather than relying only on worldly things.

reflections.title: Rebuild your connection
reflections.related: General reflection attributed in the shared description to Dr Waseem
reflections.text: A reflection that peace comes from remembering Allah and rebuilding one's connection with the Creator. The Instagram source is provided for context.
